rationale: Builds directly on the 0031 reverse-tail baseline. Local results say anchor refresh variants regressed, while tail value fp16 rescue was the closest non-baseline miss. This edit reallocates recurrent-tail float keep budget away from q/k and onto the value/projection path that actually survives into the int8 roundtrip, then narrows late EMA tracking to those same export-sensitive tail tensors instead of smearing all kept floats.
title: Recurrent Tail Value-Path Float Reallocation
